references.text: The daughters of Zelophehad, who belonged to the clan of Gilead, came forward with their case. This verse connects directly to the earlier event.
The Lord's ruling that Zelophehad's daughters should inherit their father's property, which now causes concern among the heads of the tribe.
Machir, son of Manasseh, and his descendants took possession of Gilead. This shows the lineage of those who are speaking now.
Zelophehad's daughters are mentioned again in connection with the land distribution in the book of Joshua, demonstrating the fulfillment of the law.
The heads (נְשִׂאִים) of the tribes are mentioned as leaders in Israel, holding the same authority that Moses addresses here.
The genealogy of Manasseh's sons, including Machir, Gilead, and Zelophehad's daughters.
Machir's children were born on Joseph's knees, showing the lineage back to Joseph, who is mentioned in the verse.
